q: Why is HFC-23 a concern at HCFC-22 plants?
title: HFC-23 from HCFC-22 production
short: Making HCFC-22 refrigerant produces HFC-23 as a by-product, a gas with a 100-year GWP of 14,600 under IPCC AR6. Venting even small amounts gives a large Scope 1 figure. Plants capture and destroy it in a thermal oxidiser; report generated, destroyed and vented quantities.

ul: HFC-23 generated, from measurement or the plant's own ratio.
HFC-23 destroyed, with oxidiser running hours.

p: When the oxidiser is down, by-product gas may be vented. A few days of venting can exceed a year of all other plant emissions, so log every outage.
